title: Delete blog pages and infrastructure unless a real blog post is written
description:
The blog section (pages, utils, content collection, RSS feed) exists but only has placeholder hello-world posts. The nav link has been removed. Delete all blog infrastructure:

- `website/src/pages/blog/` (all page templates)
- `website/src/utils/blog.ts`
- `website/src/pages/rss.xml.ts`
- `website/src/content/blog/` (hello-world posts)
- `website/src/components/Pagination.astro` (if only used by blog)
- Blog collection in `website/src/content.config.ts`

Skip this if we decide to write a real blog post instead.
